_comment: Fictional device/revision -> authorised procedure mapping for the capstone.
A semantically relevant and approved procedure is still rejected when it is not listed for the confirmed model|revision.
Empty lists are deliberate coverage gaps. Home-NB and P4800 Rev B power troubleshooting remain intentionally unsupported.

coverage_gap_notes.P4800|B: Deliberate gap. Rev B has no approved power procedure; the general missing-accessory procedure is not revision-specific.
coverage_gap_notes.Home-NB|*: Deliberate gap. No Home-NB customer-service procedures exist in the fictional corpus.
coverage_gap_notes.PROC-GEN-MISSING-ACCESSORY: Model-independent logistics procedure authorized for covered models.
coverage_gap_notes.PROC-SERIESM-CONTROLLER-SVC: Authorized for Series-M but restricted to service; customer-service validation must reject it.
